description: What is opening in this Texas city or ZIP? Returns pre-opening and new-outlet signals since a date, one row per address, each with a stage (applied, licensed, permitted, opened) and its source records. With no city or zip it searches all of Texas over the last 7 days (31 at most). Texas only; businesses registered with the Texas Comptroller or TABC, refreshed nightly from Texas state datasets. Filter by NAICS code or category (restaurant, bar, liquor_store, convenience_store, brewery_winery_distillery). Each row carries opening_context: what kind of opening it is (takeover of a closed business's site, ownership_change, expansion by an owner with other locations, existing_business, new_owner, ...), a confidence (high, medium, low) and a plain-language reason. Filter with opening_types and min_confidence. entity_id is null on rows owned by an individual or not linked to a taxpayer. Example: {"city": "Fort Worth", "since": "2026-07-01", "category": "restaurant", "opening_types": ["takeover"], "min_confidence": "high"}.

category.description: Business category. Ignored when naics is given.

city.description: Texas city, e.g. "Fort Worth". Omit city and zip for all of Texas.

min_confidence.description: Keep only rows whose opening_context confidence is at least this.

naics.description: NAICS code or prefix, e.g. "722511" (full-service restaurants).

opening_types.description: Keep only these kinds of opening, e.g. ["takeover", "ownership_change"]. Drops rows with no opening_context (owned by individuals).

since.description: Earliest signal date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last two years (31 days statewide). Default 90 days ago (7 statewide).

name: find_new_activity
title: New and opening businesses in a Texas area
